title: services/inward_report_service.py — InwardReportService
scope: InwardReportService.generate(date_from, date_to, supplier_ids, places, design_ids — all Optional). Mirrors SalesReportService (DS-017 shared filter predicate). Steps: (1) Build shared filter predicate list from optional params (purchase_date>=date_from, purchase_date<=date_to, supplier_id IN supplier_ids, place IN places, design_id IN design_ids). (2) Consolidation query: GROUP BY design+grade, SUM(nos), ORDER BY design_name ASC, grade_code ASC. (3) Transactions query: per-line with all joins, ORDER BY purchase_date ASC. (4) Assert sum(transactions.nos)==sum(consolidation.total_nos) before return. Returns InwardReportResponse.
